description: Source code for JSON Schema validation and reference resolution utilities within a Google API client, including functions to handle schema lookups, build JSON representations, and resolve $ref references in schemas.

methods.name: handle_schema_command
methods.description: Handles the 'gws schema' command, performing schema or method lookup and outputting JSON schema details.

methods.name: find_method
methods.description: Walks the resource tree to locate a specific method based on resource path and method name.

methods.name: build_schema_output
methods.description: Constructs a JSON representation of a method's schema, including parameters, request, and response schemas.

methods.name: param_to_json
methods.description: Converts a MethodParameter into a JSON object.

methods.name: schema_to_json
methods.description: Converts a JsonSchema into a JSON object.

methods.name: resolve_schema_refs
methods.description: Recursively resolves '$ref' fields in a JSON schema, replacing references with actual schema content.
